name: French Emergency RP 🚨
desc:
Welcome to Secours de France V5!

What exactly is “SF”?

Immerse yourself in an action-packed game where gameplay reflects reality. Choose your path with the emergency services professions: police officers, firefighters, gendarmes, highway agents, RTCF agents, and Samu teams. Each role is an adventure, a career wish!

Take part in an enhanced gaming experience with a range of advanced inventory items, exceptional vehicles and carefully designed systems.

Curious to know more? Join our social portals!
